summary: Iceberg community activity this week focused on Spark integration improvements, REST specification clarification, and infrastructure enhancements. Key discussions included Spark 4.1/4.2 framework updates, async reader optimizations, REST catalog identifier uniqueness, TLS configuration defaults, and a proposed 1.10.2 patch release for correctness fixes. The community also advanced proposals for branch merge flexibility, relative paths in the v4 spec, and Flink equality delete conversion.
highlights: Spark 4.1 framework merge and Spark 4.2 CREATE TABLE LIKE support with async reader improvements
REST Catalog specification work on identifier uniqueness across object types
TLS configuration regression discussion and Auth Manager v2 OAuth library evaluation
Apache Iceberg 1.10.2 patch release proposal for correctness issues and regressions
